prerequisites: The TFG must be defended and evaluated once it has been reliably confirmed that the student has passed all remaining subjects of the study plan and therefore has all the necessary credits to obtain the Degree, except for those corresponding to the TFG itself.

learning_outcomes.text: All basic competences of the degree, from CB1 to CB5.
All general competences of the degree, from CG1 to CG9.
All specific competences of the degree, from CE1 to CE20.

Execute, present, and defend before a university tribunal an original exercise consisting of a project in the field of Data Science and Engineering, in which the competences acquired during the degree studies are synthesized.

syllabus_topics: Topics within the area of Data Science and Engineering

assessment_methods.method: Monitoring of the student's in-person activities by their academic tutor
Final document presented by the student
Public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent discussion

assessment_rules: The Final Degree Project must be presented and defended before a university tribunal. The evaluation will generally assess the monitoring of the student's in-person activities by their academic tutor, the final document presented by the student, and the public presentation of the work before the tribunal and subsequent discussion. The final definition of the evaluation system will comply with the regulations defined in the Final Degree Regulation of the Polytechnic School of Engineering. Both ordinary and extraordinary evaluations are conducted through a public presentation before a tribunal of three professors from the School.
